study: MAFAULDA synchronized microphone and accelerometer channel-selection pilot
freeze_stage: before decompression, feature extraction, or signal inspection
selection_rule: nearest filename frequency to each predeclared target separately per state; no signals examined
split_unit: entire original recording; corresponding nominal-speed groups kept together across states
excluded: tachometer is excluded from all diagnostic features; filename speed is split metadata only

features.psd: Welch density, scipy.signal.welch, fs=50000, nperseg=4096, default Hann, noverlap=2048, detrend=constant

classifier: fixed one-nearest-neighbor using training-only feature mean and standard deviation per channel/descriptor; squared standardized feature distances averaged within each channel, then averaged over selected channels; nearest-training-row tie broken in fixed state/grid order
selection_requirement: balanced accuracy >= max(0, full-seven-channel selection balanced accuracy minus 0.02)
cost: one declared channel unit per selected diagnostic channel; this is channel-count accounting, not measured hardware dollars, energy, or latency
exact_selection: exhaust all 127 nonempty masks, minimum channel count; ties smallest integer bitmask; no test-based tie breaking
greedy: forward addition maximizing selection balanced accuracy, ties smallest resulting bitmask, stop on selection requirement
pruned_greedy: exhaust every nonempty submask of greedy result under identical selection requirement; minimum channels then smallest bitmask
test: freeze exact, greedy, pruned-greedy masks and training models before evaluating test scores; also report full panel, microphone-only, all accelerometers, and all same-cardinality panels as an unselected reference distribution
limitations: no independent device or installation sessions
six test recordings, two per class
no new excitation or sensor placement can be inferred from prerecorded fixed sensors
exactness concerns the finite selection table; physical generalization remains empirical
not the original MAFAULDA full benchmark
official landing page does not state an explicit dataset license; raw data are not redistributed
